response.sql: SELECT AVG(length) AS average_running_time, AVG(replacement_cost / NULLIF(rental_rate, 0)) AS average_replacement_cost_to_rental_rate_ratio FROM film WHERE length >= 112

assumptions.assumption: Treats the cutoff as inclusive: a long film has a length of at least 112 minutes.

alternatives.interpretation: If “112 minutes as the cutoff” means strictly longer than 112 minutes, use this condition instead.
